label: ManufacturingChangeCompliance process: Verify Employee Safety Requirements — Confirm that affected manufacturing personnel meet updated occupational health and safety certifications required for the modified production process.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY FINDING - ManufacturingChangeCompliance Process:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Directly part of proc_ManufacturingChangeCompliance_v1 (BPMN process group)
- Orchestrates engineering changes across production materials and items
- Key capabilities: manage-change-impact, schedule-machines, orchestrate-production-change, etc.
- Coordinates with material and product item management for production order adjustments

EHS SAFETY COMPLIANCE:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
- Monitors engineering changes, materials, product items for safety compliance
- Validates product configurations against safety standards
- Detects regulatory gaps and initiates compliance remediation
- Handles hazardous substance assessment
- Does NOT verify employee certifications/qualifications

WORKDAY HCM EMPLOYEE SAFETY:
Agent: workday.hcm:agent:OccupationalSafetyIncidentMonitoring:v1
- Tracks employee exposure events with hazardous materials
- Triggers safety alerts for affected personnel
- Does NOT verify pre-requisite employee certifications

FINDING: No resource found that specifically verifies manufacturing personnel meet updated occupational health and safety certifications for modified production processes. Landscape covers product/material safety and incident tracking but lacks employee certification verification capability.

args.reason: Automates safety compliance validation for engineering changes in manufacturing and detects regulatory gaps that would include occupational health certification requirements.
